baseline.role: canonical image for all real-machine measurements (COORDINATION section 4)

liteprofiler.repo_digest_note: locally built only, never pushed - identity is the image id + the two commit layer ids below, NOT a registry digest
liteprofiler.role: phase-timing image (prepare input / forward / post process / sample_token)

patch_verification.method: git patch-id --stable of (git diff <baseline-commit>..<liteprofiler-HEAD>) vs the raw .patch file: identical ids prove the image contains exactly the patch content, nothing more; worktree dirty-line counts prove nothing is left uncommitted.
patch_verification.conclusion: the liteprofiler image differs from the baseline ONLY by the two LiteProfiler patches (committed on top of the baseline commits, worktrees clean)

notes: The liteprofiler patch is COMMITTED inside the image, so the container worktree is clean - a naive `git status` comparison against the baseline shows nothing. Verify via the commit ancestry + patch-id, not via porcelain output.
Layer ids of the liteprofiler image are docker-commit layers created with the container cmd `sleep infinity`; they carry the source commits, there are no package-manager layers.
